sentences.en: The situation will soon revert to the way things were before.
sentences.zh: 情况很快就会恢复到以前的状态。

sentences.en: This should be reverted back to the original.
sentences.zh: 这应该恢复到原来的设置。

sentences.en: The key combination ctrl-Z reverts your changes.
sentences.zh: 组合键Ctrl-Z可以撤销你的更改，使其恢复原状。

senses.zh: 恢复；重提；返祖遗传；归还
